particle basis state (any).note: Fock basis = computational basis: S=(0,0,0); single particles carry NO entanglement in this frame

color-uniform dbar (W state).note: SU(3)-flavor-symmetric weight-1 combo = the W state, tau3=0

color-uniform u (W-bar state).note: weight-2 uniform combo = flipped W state

nu + e+ (GHZ).note: GHZ = maximal violation of charge superselection (Delta Q = 1)

gauge_vs_entanglement.note: A color rotation (DFT in color space) maps a separable quark state to an entangled one: gauge transformations are NOT local unitaries of the qubit factorization. Entanglement in the JW frame is gauge-frame dependent; only gauge-invariant combinations of invariants can be physical.
